name: Seat
description: One seat on any seat map (booking, check-in, Manage Booking). Each seat type has its own outline colour and glyph; tapping previews the seat, and committing happens in the selection panel.

provenance.tag: Rec (D18): type outlines, glyphs and preview state; status visuals: A · unverified; seat types: Official

source.tag: Look: A · unverified ("white with fine grey outline"). Colour: Rec, raised from #A9A9A9 (2.35:1).

variants.name: preferred
variants.description: --color-seat-bg fill, 2px --color-seat-preferred outline (--gold-600 bronze, 3.90:1), star glyph in --color-seat-preferred.

source.tag: Gold family: A · unverified. Bronze shade and glyph: Rec.
Rec. No source gives a Twin style.

props.name: type
props.description: Official seat types. Each type has its own outline colour and glyph (D18).

props.name: status
props.description: previewed = tapped, shown in the selection panel, not yet confirmed.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: The full spoken description, built and localised by the feature layer, e.g. "34K, window, Extra Legroom, USD 45, available". The seat itself shows no text.

props.name: onPreview
props.description: Tap, click, Enter or Space. Opens the selection panel. Committing happens in the panel ("Confirm seat"), not on the seat.

states.name: previewed
states.visual: --color-seat-hover-bg fill + 2px --color-seat-previewed (red) outline replacing the type outline; the type glyph switches to Fill weight. The selection panel shows this seat's details. Red, not black, so it stands out on Extra Legroom seats.

states.name: selected
states.visual: --color-seat-selected fill (red), white check icon (Fill weight) replaces the type glyph.

states.name: occupied
states.visual: --color-seat-occupied-bg fill with a diagonal hatch (repeating-linear-gradient in --neutral-300). No outline, no glyph. Not clickable.

source.tag: A · unverified (light grey + cross-hatch). Colour remapped from #E2E2E6 to the Live neutral.

interaction: Tap or click → previewed: the selection panel shows seat number, type, position, price for the active passenger and a Confirm seat button. Nothing is committed yet.
Confirm (in the panel) → selected, after the server accepts it.
Pointer hover may additionally show a price tooltip; it is never the only way to see the price.
The seat does not take a price. Prices come from the seat-map API per passenger and are shown in SeatLegend and the selection panel.

requirements: A gridcell containing a <button> named by accessibleLabel.
Occupied seats are announced as "34K, occupied" and have aria-disabled="true"; they stay in the grid so arrow keys can pass over them.
Seat type is never shown by colour alone: every type has a glyph.
size sm (28px) meets the 24px AA target minimum.
keyboard: Enter or Space previews an available seat.

rtl: Seat grid columns follow the cabin layout data; arrow keys follow the visual direction (handled by SeatMap).
rules: At size sm (28px) the 16px glyph still fits inside a 2px outline.
Seat fees (Official, indicative USD): Regular 7–40, Preferred 15–100, Twin 20–135, Extra Legroom 30–260. They vary by route, season, fare and Skywards tier; the server supplies them. Never hardcode.

ambiguities.description: The occupied hatch uses the primitive --neutral-300 directly; no semantic token exists for it.
